name: PPIO
description: Decentralised compute platform reselling open models with a small starter credit.
overview: PPIO is a decentralised GPU cloud that also exposes open models — DeepSeek V4 Flash and other popular weights — through an OpenAI-compatible inference API. New accounts receive ¥5 of credit, roughly five million DeepSeek-V3 tokens, which is enough for evaluation; beyond that it is per-token billing. Registration requires real-name verification and a mainland payment method for top-ups.
notes: Small credit; the startup programme offers larger grants by application.
